title: The Cold Tea Cup Contradiction
description:
Witness B: 'The victim poured steaming hot tea 1 minute before he died at 9:00 PM.'
Forensic Test: The tea cup on the desk was frozen solid with ice.
question: Which witness is lying?
acceptable_answer_format:
Type only the witness name.

Example:
Witness B
hints: Steaming tea cannot freeze solid in 1 minute.
solution_explanation: Steaming hot tea cannot turn into solid ice within 1 minute. Witness B's claim contradicts physical facts.
